en: Psalms 136

p.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

p.src: 2  Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 2  Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

p.src: 3  Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 3  Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 4  to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 4  to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 5  to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 5  to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 6  to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 6  to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 7  to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 7  to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 8  the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 8  the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 9  the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 9  the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 10  to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 10  to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 11  and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 11  and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 12  with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 12  with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 13  to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 13  to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 14  and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 14  and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 15  but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 15  but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 16  to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 16  to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 17  to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 17  to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 18  and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 18  and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 19  Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 19  Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 20  Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 20  Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 21  and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 21  and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 22  even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 22  even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 23  who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 23  who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 24  and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

en: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 24  and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 25  who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 25  who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

p.src: 26  Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 26  Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
